messages.subject: Adding mean with 95% CI to boxplots
messages.subject_clean: Adding mean with 95% CI to boxplots
messages.body_plain:
I want to add means and 95% confidence intervals to boxplots. I cannot figure out how to do it with the plot builder so am doing a hack from the Rcmdr.plugin KMggplot after I have created my boxplot with the plot builder.
Thanks

messages.subject: Re: Adding mean with 95% CI to boxplots
messages.subject_clean: Adding mean with 95% CI to boxplots
messages.body_plain:
One way of achieving this would be to add a grouped mean plot to the existing grouped box plot to overlay the two plots. Options, axes, etc can then be adjusted as required.

On Sunday, January 3, 2016 at 11:04:14 AM UTC+10, moopsdad wrote:
> I want to add means and 95% confidence intervals to boxplots. I cannot figure out how to do it with the plot builder so am doing a hack from the Rcmdr.plugin KMggplot after I have created my boxplot with the plot builder.
> Thanks
messages.body_snippet:
One way of achieving this would be to add a grouped mean plot to the existing grouped box plot to overlay the two plots. Options, axes, etc can then be adjusted as required.

messages.subject: Re: data import errors
messages.body_plain:
Occasionally R’s spss importer can not read a valid spss .sav file. There isn’t a lot that Deducer can do about this. You did the right thing to convert it to a csv file.

best,
Ian
